adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `updateAllCalendarEvents(...)`, the `catch` block previously did `console.error(message);` but the diff removes that line and now only returns an array of failure `EventResult`s via `Promise.resolve(calendarReference?.map(...))`. There is no replacement logging in the new `catch` block, so calendar update failures will be surfaced only as returned failure entries without any server-side trace from this code path. This is an observability/diagnostics regression rather than a direct functional correctness defect.
